# add qase entrypoint

Add an entrypoint named `qase` for routing certain SSH-based commands, `git clone` being the given example, through it. That is the whole of the original text; what `qase` refers to — a host, a jump server, a project or a tool of the author's workplace at the time — is not recorded in the repository, and the "help wanted" label suggests the design was open.

The reading that fits the example: a wrapper that recognises repositories belonging to that context and runs the `git clone` (or another SSH-backed command) with the right SSH host, key or proxy configuration, so that the user does not have to spell out `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` or a `~/.ssh/config` host alias each time.
